name: Sodium Cocaminopropionate
description: Sodium Cocaminopropionate (CAS 68608-68-4 ) is a mild amphoteric surfactant derived from coconut fatty acids and beta-alanine. It functions as a cleansing, foaming, and conditioning agent across a broad pH range. This versatile ingredient tolerates high electrolyte concentrations that often challenge conventional surfactants. In personal care formulations, it acts as a primary or co-surfactant in shampoos and body washes. It is particularly valued in facial cleansers where mildness to skin and hair is a formulation priority. Its compatibility with both anionic and cationic systems makes it effective in conditioning shampoos. The product is also used in leave-on treatments where charge balance matters for performance. In home care and industrial cleaning, it contributes to hard surface cleaners and degreasers. It provides stable foam and soil removal at varying pH levels for industrial applications. It also functions as a foam booster and viscosity modifier in liquid detergent concentrates. By using this surfactant, manufacturers can reduce the need for additional co-surfactants in their formulas. It is typically supplied as an aqueous solution with active matter concentrations of 30–40%. The material is available in technical and cosmetic grades to meet specific industry requirements. Cosmetic-grade material meets the purity and safety standards required for leave-on applications. Packaging options for this chemical generally include drums and IBCs for bulk procurement.
